description: Get AI tools that are trending on GateOnAI by a fixed rule: at least 3 clicks to the tool's own website from GateOnAI visitors in the last 7 days (bots not counted). The list can be empty; the answer then says so and suggests whats_new (recently added tools) or search_ai_tools.

limit.description: Number of trending tools to return (default: 10, max: 20)

name: get_trending_tools

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Get Trending Tools
